thread:
faith: hey folks, new hire here. who owns the billing pipeline docs, rate-limit configs, and the SLA contact list? i need to change a threshold for a test invoice job and don't want to touch the wrong repo.

rami: welcome @faith! :wave: short map: billing pipeline infra + configs -> eng-platform; rate limit/runtime rules -> eng-runtime; SLA contacts and customer escalation -> people-ops (they keep the canonical contact sheet).

faith: where are the specific repos/docs?

rami: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing-pipeline. repo: `payments/billing-pipeline`. Rate-limit rules live in `runtime/ratelimits/` and SLA contacts are referenced from the Ownership Matrix -> link in the top of the docs.

ops-bot: Current billing oncall: nora -> mateo. Pager channel: #eng-oncall-billing. Next rotation: 2026-04-15 09:00 UTC.

faith: do i need approval to tweak thresholds in staging vs prod?

rami: staging tweaks are fine with an internal PR and a short note in the billing channel. Prod changes need an approval: paste this template in #eng-runtime: 
``nRequest: change rate limit threshold
Service: billing-pipeline
Env: prod
Change: raise threshold X->Y for rollout test
Owner: faith
Approver: eng-runtime lead
Urgency: low
``
Also include rollback steps and a 30-min canary.

people-ops: For SLA contacts we require the People Ops form to add or update customer-facing phone numbers. Ping us and we'll walk you through the form. Sensitive numbers are stored in the secure Owners sheet (request access from security).

faith: awesome, super clear. i'll open the PR for staging first and then the prod ticket when ready. thanks! :pray:
